name: intelligent-model-routing
description:
Routes AI/LLM requests to different models using LLM-powered classification.
An LLM analyzes each incoming request against user-defined routing rules (each with a name and context description) and selects the best-matching model.
Effective for categorizing requests by topic or intent (e.g., coding questions, creative writing, customer support) and routing each to the most suitable model.
When no rule matches, requests fall back to a configurable default model.

Note: This policy requires an LLM provider (OpenAI or Azure OpenAI) to be configured for classification.
